WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    o.lunarstage,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) as avg_bw,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bw) as overall_avg FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step1.lunarstage,
    step1.avg_bw,
    step1.cnt,
    step1.avg_bw - step2.overall_avg as diff
  FROM step1
  CROSS JOIN step2
  WHERE step1.avg_bw > step2.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_bw) as avg_of_filtered_bandwidths,
  SUM(cnt) as total_matching_records,
  AVG(diff) as avg_of_differences
FROM step3
